steps.title: Identify runs for examination
steps.instruction: Access the tracking documentation to determine which recent runs require quality control.

substeps.instruction: Open the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).
Check out and open the Excel Tracking Sheet.
Locate the most recent runs at the bottom of the sheet.

steps.title: Review image series
steps.instruction: Examine the specific runplan images within the LIMS.

substeps.instruction: Search for the image series of the runplan to be examined in the LIMS.

steps.title: Record QC pass/fail status
steps.instruction: Determine the status of the run and update the tracking sheet and LIMS accordingly.

substeps.instruction: If the run passes: select "Pass" from the dropdown in the "QC" column of the Excel Tracking Sheet.
If the run fails: select "Fail" from the dropdown in the "QC" column of the Excel Tracking Sheet and specify reasons in the "QC Comments" column.
For failed runs: search for the runplan in the LIMS, select "Edit", and change the "Runplan state" to "fail".

steps.title: Perform post-annotation QA update
steps.instruction: Periodically review runplans after Data Annotation group analysis and update records.

substeps.instruction: Review recently annotated runplans to determine pass/fail status.
Update the Excel Tracking Sheet by noting Pass/Fail in the "QA" column and entering comments from the Data Annotation group.
Update the "Runplan state" in the LIMS: set to "fail" for runplans failed by Annotation and "pass" for those passed by Annotation.

steps.title: Finalize documentation
steps.instruction: Save and check in the Excel Tracking Sheet to allow editing by other users.
